channel.title: News | CODAC
channel.description: Announcements and updates from the DIGICAMS center.

item.title: Six center papers accepted across CDC, ACC, ECC, IFAC and Asilomar
item.description: Work from across the center appears at the Conference on Decision and Control, the American Control Conference, the European Control Conference, IFAC and Asilomar.

item.title: Tyler Hanks and Cristian Nino complete their PhDs
item.description: Two of the center's students have finished: Tyler Hanks on coordination sheaves, and Cristian Nino on multi-agent tracking and control.

item.title: UF features the center's work on coordinating autonomous units
item.description: The Herbert Wertheim College of Engineering covered DIGICAMS and the problem of getting drone swarms to decide together rather than separately.

item.title: AFOSR awards the DIGICAMS Center of Excellence
item.description: AFOSR awarded the center for Designing Integrated, Generic, and Interoperable Compositional Analyses of Modern Systems on 19 May 2025.
